einstellungen.text: Tonight, your little brother's bedroom falls apart. Forever.
Bo is nine. He grips the door frame like the room might fly away without him.
"The heat regulator's broken. We need his wall."
Your mom is the station's mechanic.
You live in the living ring of an old space station. Twelve rooms in a circle, above an orange planet.
Without the regulator, the ring freezes in two days.
The station can repair itself. But only with a room you empty out and give up.
There are seven marks on Bo's wall. One for every birthday.
"The wall stays. And so do I."
The floor is cold under your knees. You've got an idea.
You stick a long strip of tape to the wall and trace every mark. With the date.
Bo rolls it up. Now his whole wall fits in his pocket.
Your mom checks the empty room. Then she taps release.
The yellow walls break into glowing tiles. It smells like warm plastic.
On the model, the yellow segment turns gray.
The regulator jumps to green. Warm air rushes across the floor.
And right next door, five more rooms report damage.
